entries.title: Overview drag-and-drop & navigation polish
changes: Returning to today now winds farther and takes longer based on how many days you travelled. A year away has a much longer rewind than a week away.
The winding date count, spring settle, and activity-ring reveal stay connected throughout the return.
Overview cards now reveal their destination with a smooth expanding transition from the tap, while the shared bars stay in place.
Press and hold an Overview card, then drag it to rearrange your dashboard. Cards lift, neighbors slide aside, and the layout saves when you drop.
The Edit button still manages hidden cards. Dragging near the screen edges scrolls the dashboard.
Life Director activity centers use compact, non-scrolling summaries and keep the main action visible. Dragging inside the center no longer scrolls the dashboard or top bar.

Hold a time on the Life Director’s outer track to schedule a pinned activity. The form starts at that date and time; moving your finger still rotates the calendar. Requires an already planned day and a free time slot.

Native Cat (beta): Play opens a toy tray right on the Cat tab. Pick a toy and a cat that feels like it comes to pick it up, carry it, toss it and chase it; a sleepy or hungry cat tells you why it won’t.
Native Cat (beta): two cats no longer lie on top of each other in one bed or stay in bed for hours, and after a meal a rested cat gets up and about instead of going straight back to sleep.
Native Cat (beta): the cats no longer rest hidden behind the sofa; resting spots by the sofa keep them in view.

Native Cat (beta): two cats now live together. They touch noses (and, while they are still strangers, hiss), chase each other, groom each other, curl up together for a nap and settle standoffs over a perch; a kitten follows the grown cat about. The Together card counts what they did, with the last moment and the pecking order, and “While you were away” mentions what they shared.
Native Cat (beta): the pale outline around the cats in the Overview card and the Cat tab is gone.
Native Cat (beta): a resting cat no longer shimmers. Its breathing is now a clean one-pixel lift, so the coat stays steady instead of popping and flickering.
Scrubbing along the bottom bar now keeps going when your finger passes over or ends on Quest. A scrub that starts on Quest still uses the older scrubber until Quest is native.
Native Cat (beta): cats now turn round step by step, through a three-quarter and a front view, instead of just flipping. It takes about a third of a second.
Native Cat (beta): cats no longer poke through the cat tree. A cat scratches the post from in front of the tree, and one passing under its platform is drawn in front of it.

entries.title: Life Director polish & update history
changes: Read what changed in Settings → Phone & sync → App updates → What’s new.
Unplanned dates show your sleep and work hours, with a message that the day hasn’t been planned yet.
Double-tap an empty corner outside the Life Director dial to return to today with a winding animation.
The date fades into your current activity while its colored ring draws around the dial center.
Dial rotation keeps following your thumb after it drifts away from the outer rim.
Switch Life Director sections by tapping their buttons; accidental sideways swipes no longer change sections.
